name: The Research Digest
summary: An editorial research identity that makes an update readable and its follow-through accountable.

palette.name: Background
palette.evidence: Native Office page/sheet white ground; explicit design choice retaining the reading surface.

palette.name: Text
palette.evidence: used style Normal explicit text color

palette.name: Digest purple
palette.evidence: Native reference.docx word/document.xml active shading/border value #673D74; source visual and native-design-style-audit corroboration.

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style RecordHeading.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style Small.

recognitionRules: Use Impact for the digest masthead and Gill Sans for reading text.
Keep issue number, date and first-read context above the story.
Use purple bands with white section labels and purple source links to distinguish New Evidence from Decision & Follow-through; keep Impact headlines black.
Give follow-through an owner, action and status rather than a vague closing recommendation.

principles: Move from observation to interpretation to a bounded next question.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Read the update. Keep the record. Know who moves next.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid “proves” when the material only supports a hypothesis.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: A record suggests a direction; it does not speak for every person.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use THE RESEARCH DIGEST as an Impact masthead with a small Gill Sans issue line. No news icon.
invariants: Use Impact for the digest masthead and Gill Sans for reading text.
Keep issue number, date and first-read context above the story.
Use purple bands with white section labels and purple source links to distinguish New Evidence from Decision & Follow-through; keep Impact headlines black.
adaptations: A short edition may include one finding and one action.
Archive pages retain issue dates and source identifiers.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Impact is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.
Gill Sans is an Apple/system or separately licensed font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
